Dispute-Challenge-Comment.description: Additional explanation or comment for the challenge, if needed.

Dispute-Challenge-Evidences.description:
A list of IDs of previously uploaded evidence files to associate with this challenge.

:::warning
Each evidence ID can only be used for **a single challenge**. This means, that evidences already assigned to a challenge **cannot be reused** for other challenges.
:::

items.description: ID of a previously uploaded evidence file.

Dispute-Challenge-Reason.description: The reason for challenging the dispute.
